howToUse_step1_desc: Start by giving your trip a name, entering your destination, and selecting your travel dates. The more specific you are, the better the AI can tailor your plan.
howToUse_step2_desc: Choose your budget, select your interests (like food, history, or nature), and set the pace of your trip. This helps the AI understand what kind of activities you'll enjoy.
howToUse_step3_desc: Click the 'Generate Itinerary' button. The AI will create a complete, day-by-day plan. You can also generate a 'Quick Plan' for a high-level summary.
howToUse_step4_desc: Your generated trip is automatically saved. You can load it later, share it with friends, or download it as a PDF to take with you on the go!
about_p1: SmartTour AI is an intelligent travel planner designed to simplify the process of creating amazing, personalized travel itineraries. Forget spending hours researching and planning; our powerful AI does the heavy lifting for you.
about_p2: Built with cutting-edge generative AI, this tool understands your unique preferences to craft a trip that's perfectly suited to your style. From detailed daily activities to cost estimates and booking links, we provide everything you need to embark on your next adventure with confidence.
